relations: Dante 牢房紧挨 Jazz 与 River；对外叫她 Pixie、私下叫 Angel。
Reaper 是 River 宿敌，两大帮派：River 定公平规矩，Reaper 想统治全狱。
Reaper 是 hybrid，有扭曲 fae 魔法，杀过很多人上过新闻。
天使须缔结 mate bond 才能触及最深魔法，包办结偶因此极常见；Dante 主动提出必要时愿与她结 bond。

facts.fact: Dante 估约一百人被冤关，也许略少略多。
facts.anchor: I would guess around a hundred. Maybe a few less. Maybe a few more.

facts.fact: 第一个无辜者是约三十年前送进来的。
facts.anchor: How long ago was the first one sent here?" I asked quietly

facts.fact: Dante 表明：若必须结 mate 才能救大家，他愿意。
facts.anchor: I want to make it clear that if you have to take a mate to get us out of here, I'm willing to do it.

facts.fact: Dante 递来笔记本短铅笔，她开始画编织图。
facts.anchor: Dante handed me the small, thin notebook and stubby pencil that someone had given him earlier, and I got to work.

facts.fact: 第三天 Dante 血渴虚弱仍坚持让她先吃饭再咬她。
facts.anchor: he insisted that I had to eat before he bit me, so that I had a better chance of recovering.

facts.fact: 转弯处 Dante 把她护在身后，低声问 Reaper 想要什么。
facts.anchor: What do you want, Reaper?" Dante asked in a low voice

facts.fact: Reaper 要求她明天离开吸血鬼保姆来帮派过一天，她应下。
facts.anchor: We'd like you to spend your day tomorrow with our gang. Without the vampiric babysitter.

facts.fact: 警报响起，魔法只让 Dante 咽下一口血就把他拖进独居室。
facts.anchor: The alarm went off, and my magic took hold of him before he got more than a mouthful of my blood down.
